known_limitations.detail: FastAPI endpoints and end-to-end real API integration are planned.
DetectionService intentionally supports only the selected six-class model; the generic 17-class alternative requires a separate explicit mapping.
The 17-class alternative required a 0.05 diagnostic threshold and produced two detections on one of three NEU-DET probe images; the stronger six-class model is selected.
SQLite metadata and media persistence are implemented; HTTP history integration and CSV export are planned.
The required ten-image manufacturing dataset and provenance manifest are not present.
Core and inspection-service inference plus annotated outputs are verified; HTTP, live backend, persistence, and server CSV paths are not runtime-verified.
Detection and persistence unit tests, evidence freshness checks, import-boundary checks, frontend utility tests, and builds exist; component, API, and end-to-end automation remain planned.
